Proposed diagram changes
  |-- ChangeSession - domain model and call tree  existing canvas
      |-- [1a] Correct [MODEL] ChangeSession ownership
      |   `-- Replace the obsolete DiagramService dependency; show pinned repository, commits, head and comparison base, per-document repository ownership, DiffTree and paired migrations.
      |-- [1b] Extend [CALLS] ChangeSession operations
      |   `-- Introduce DiffSessionWorkflowService as the Git-driven workflow owner: API and PushIntegrationService call it; it owns persisted runs and calls ChangeSessionService to capture, edit and ready an isolated proposal. Show DiffTree readers as callers of ChangeSessionService.
      |-- [1b] Extend [H] Isolated history and undo/redo
      |   `-- Clarify that proposal checkpoints and per-document versions belong to isolated controller history; legacy history is imported when reopened.
      |-- [1b] Extend [P] Session persistence and reopening
      |   `-- Include persisted DiffTree generations and pinned context; distinguish ChangeSession records from persisted workflow runs and push generations.
      |-- [1b] Extend [D] Baseline/proposed -> unified review
      |   `-- Identify shared core node matching, diagram diff and row projection used by this preview and presentation Compare; keep preview rendering separate from acceptance.
      |-- [1b] Extend [A] Ready validation and atomic acceptance
      |   `-- Add DiffTree and paired-migration validation, repository ownership checks, unchanged live-baseline and saved-head guards; retain atomic catalog publication and receipt recovery.
      |-- [2] Add: Git-driven ChangeSession workflow
      |   `-- Attach to the new DiffSessionWorkflowService owner in [CALLS]; detail pinned capture, analysis/materialization, constrained tools, push-triggered calls and persisted run outcomes.
      `-- [2] Add: DiffTree and hunk navigation
          `-- Attach to the ChangeSessionService DiffTree reader/owner in [CALLS]; detail captured hunk IDs, tree mappings, selected-node resolution and navigation to proposal diagrams.
  |-- Canvas domain model - baseline 03f2168 (before tldraw) - Projection  existing canvas
      |-- [1b] Extend [P1] Presentation alternatives - choose what a placement shows
      |   `-- At Compare, identify the shared core matcher and diff-row projection also consumed by ChangeSession [D]; selection and side-panel comparison still leave bound content unchanged.
      `-- [1b] Clarify [P2] Review versus presentation - two independent operations
          `-- Keep review's structural decisions and three-way application distinct from the shared presentation matcher and ChangeSession acceptance.
  |-- Roll-up 1 - g2 - Canvas domain model - baseline 03f2168 (before tldraw)  existing canvas
      `-- [1b] Extend [P1] Presentation alternatives
          `-- Show shared core diagram-diff and row projection for diff choices and side panels without changing the bound revision.
  `-- Roll-up 2 - g2 - Canvas domain model - baseline 03f2168 (before tldraw)  existing canvas
      `-- [1b] Extend [P] Placement choices and revision review
          `-- Show shared diff presentation for comparison while keeping review application and content binding separate.
